title: Soft backend: add CKM_AES_GCM
description: wolfCrypt has wc_AesGcmEncrypt and wc_AesGcmDecrypt but wolfP11 does not expose CKM_AES_GCM. Implement AES-GCM encrypt/decrypt in wp11_backend_soft.c (or wp11_pkcs11.c for symmetric), add CKM_AES_GCM to g_mechs[], and handle the IV/tag/AAD parameters passed via CK_GCM_PARAMS.
